lines.zh: 我用手臂撑着地，一步一步爬。
lines.en: I brace on my arms and crawl step by step.

lines.zh: 我的手指抓进土里，拖着自己。
lines.en: My fingers dig into the soil and drag me on.

lines.zh: 我脊背拱起来，又塌下去。
lines.en: My back arches, then sags.
I move low and quick.
I crawl with my mouth open.

lines.zh: 我从草里出来，草被压平。
lines.en: I come out of the grass and it lies flat.
I crawl toward the movement.

lines.zh: 我的骨节在地上磕出声。
lines.en: My joints knock on the ground.
I pass a skeleton without stopping.

lines.zh: 我爬得歪，一条腿使不上力。
lines.en: I crawl crooked; one leg will not work.
I shuffle forward, dragging my shadow.

lines.zh: 我把自己从坑里拉出来。
lines.en: I haul myself out of a pit.
I lie low, mouth half open.

lines.zh: 我的手指一下一下地抓土。
lines.en: My fingers claw the dirt.
I lift my head; the neck clicks.
I hold still and only watch.
I breathe, very low.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨从皮下顶出来。
lines.en: My ribs press through the skin.
I lie flat, fingertips digging into mud.
I stop and count your steps.
I wait. I am patient.
I close my mouth a little.
I squint and gauge the distance to you.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼皮，只看见你的腿。
lines.en: I lift my eyelids and see only your legs.
I press my body forward.
I have no fangs, but I can tear.

lines.zh: 你退，我的手指就伸出去。
lines.en: You back away; my fingers reach.
I tilt my head toward your legs.
I am quite clear on where you stand.

lines.zh: 我用手臂把自己撑起来。
lines.en: I push myself up on my arms.
My breath brushes your feet.
I reach for your boot.
I am cut open and still crawl forward.
I give half a step, hand still out.
I fall and push myself up.
I lose a piece. It returns quickly.
A muffled note sounds inside me.
I press my body to the ground.
I pause half a beat and crawl on.
My breathing scatters for a while.
I press the wound to the ground.
I turn toward you, a little slower.
This does not suit my mouth.
It is dead. I will not eat it.
What I want is something that moves.
I do not sniff it; I crawl around it.
I touch it with a finger.
It does not struggle. No fun.
I go back to staring at you.
Hold it as long as you like. I will not stir.
I edge toward your feet.
I press my hand over it.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我一下贴住你。
lines.en: You collide; I cling to you at once.

lines.zh: 我被撞得偏了，手还抓着地。
lines.en: Knocked aside, my hand still grips.

lines.zh: 我的手指勾到你的裤脚。
lines.en: My fingers hook your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，骨头咯了一下。
lines.en: We collide; something grates.
I use the moment to climb.
I slide down your leg.
I push you backward.
I do not let go.
I give half a step, still in front.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在你靴上划出声。
lines.en: My nails rasp on your boot.
Another drags itself up out of the soil.
We lie side by side, breathing together.
I push what I caught toward it.

lines.zh: 我们头挨着头，一起喘气。
lines.en: Heads together, we breathe in time.
Our hands meet.

lines.zh: 它比我完整一点，也慢一点。
lines.en: It is more whole, and slower.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝同一个方向爬。
lines.en: We crawl the same way.

lines.zh: 它伏在我背上，歇了一会儿。
lines.en: It rests on my back a while.
We part and each hunts.
It leaves first. I do not follow.
I take it in my hand.
I touch it with the tip of my nose.
I bite once. Hard.

lines.zh: 我把它按在身下的土里。
lines.en: I press it into the soil under me.

lines.zh: 嚼了两下才发觉不是肉，我吐了出来。
lines.en: Two chews told me it was not flesh, and I spat it out.

lines.zh: 我把它压在身下，继续爬。
lines.en: I pin it under me and keep crawling.
It does not move in my hand.
I stuff it into the soil.
I stare at it for a good while.
I drop it and crawl on.
My neck jerks, and I settle on you.

lines.zh: 我的手指立刻抓紧地面。
lines.en: My fingers grip the ground.
I start crawling your way.
I stretch my body out.
You give a step; I crawl one.
My mouth begins to work.
I have chosen your ankle.
I quicken my crawl.
All ten fingers point at you.
I push my torso up and stare at you.
I am done waiting.
I begin to rush at you.

lines.zh: 你的味道顺着风飘下来。
lines.en: Your scent drifts down on the wind.

lines.zh: 你脚底那片土我记住了。
lines.en: I have noted the soil under your feet.
There is very little between us now.

lines.zh: 我的下颌张到最大，对准你。
lines.en: My jaw opens wide, aimed at you.
This time I will not miss.
I follow, crawling the whole way.
You run fast; I chase low.
My hands reach out again and again.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我还在过来。
lines.en: You back to the wall; I keep coming.
I cross a ditch without stopping.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在地上留下痕。
lines.en: My nails leave marks on the ground.

lines.zh: 你把门关上，我从缝里过。
lines.en: You shut the door; I go through the gap.
I do not call out. I only breathe.

lines.zh: 我把这点距离一点点磨掉。
lines.en: I wear the distance down bit by bit.

lines.zh: 你每落一步，我都记下了。
lines.en: I note every step you set down.
I have climbed the steps.

lines.zh: 我贴着地，爬到你的侧面。
lines.en: Low to the ground, I work to your flank.
You turn; I flatten.
You cut me; I still advance.
I crowd you toward the corner.

lines.zh: 我爬进你的影子里，停下。
lines.en: I crawl into your shadow and stop.
I am one arm's length away.
I pause half a beat, then move.

lines.zh: 我饿得发昏，已经锁定了你。
lines.en: Hunger has left me dizzy, and I have already locked onto you.
I do not plan to leave tonight.

lines.zh: 我整个人扑上去，抱住你的腿。
lines.en: I throw myself on you and grab your leg.
My fingers dig into your skin.
I open my mouth and gnaw your boot.
I ram you down with my body.

lines.zh: 这一下扑空，我摔了个跟头。
lines.en: The lunge misses and I take a spill.
I climb up your leg.
My nails rake your hand.
One pull and you are on your knees.
You kick; I catch your boot.
I press on your back. Heavy.
I hit your waist from the side.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的膝盖，往后拖。
lines.en: I clamp your knee and drag back.
You throw me off; I rise again.

lines.zh: 我一口啃穿了你的护腿。
lines.en: My bite crunches through your leggings.
I climb toward your neck.
Breathing hard, my hands keep working.
I crawl up out of the soil.
I push my upper body up first.

lines.zh: 我的手指抓到第一把土。
lines.en: My fingers take their first grip on soil.
This ground smells of something living.

lines.zh: 我先听见脚步，才睁开眼。
lines.en: I hear your steps before I open my eyes.
Mud still clings to me.

lines.zh: 我开始朝有声音的方向爬。
lines.en: I crawl toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我在地上留下长长的痕。
lines.en: I leave a long trail on the ground.
My breathing comes rough.

lines.zh: 我试着用手臂撑起自己。
lines.en: I try to lift myself on my arms.
I find a pit and lie low.
I have memorized this ground.
I start working toward the edge.
I work up from under the grass roots.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的皮，我手脚乱蹬。
lines.en: Fire catches my skin; my limbs thrash.
I fall and my bones come loose.

lines.zh: 水没到我的胸口，我挣不上来。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I cannot climb out.
The blast flips me onto the ground.
An arrow pins me down for a moment.

lines.zh: 那光钻进我骨头里，很冷。
lines.en: That light crawls into my bones, cold.
Too hungry to crawl.

lines.zh: 雷打进我身体，我整个人抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning enters me; my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 黑暗把我从地上拽起来。
lines.en: Darkness lifts me off the ground.
